contract.title: Extended Warranty Agreement
contract.hint: Read the Extended Warranty Agreement below, scroll to the bottom and confirm to continue with payment.

sections.title: 1. Definitions and scope
sections.body: This agreement is entered into between the policyholder (vehicle owner) and the extended warranty provider (insurer) for the vehicle extended warranty service. The insured vehicle is identified by its VIN. This agreement applies to covered failures occurring during the coverage period. The owner confirms having read and understood all clauses before signing.

sections.title: 2. Scope of coverage
sections.body: During the coverage period, the insurer bears the repair cost of the following components failing due to manufacturing defects or normal use: engine, transmission and electrical system (according to the selected product's coverage). Each repair is limited to the insured amount stated in the policy.

sections.title: 3. Exclusions
sections.body: Losses caused by the following are excluded: traffic accidents, intentional damage, failure to follow the maintenance manual, unauthorised modifications, flooding, force majeure, misuse, and normal wear of consumable parts. Refer to the full exclusions in the official contract.

sections.title: 4. Claims procedure
sections.body: In case of breakdown, report it within 24 hours via the portal or the customer service line, visit an authorised repair centre, and keep the repair order and receipts. Once the claim is approved, the repair cost will be settled as agreed.

sections.title: 5. Term and termination
sections.body: Coverage begins at 00:00 on the day after payment. During the cooling-off period you may cancel with a full refund of the premium; after that period, cancellation is subject to an agreed deduction.

sections.title: 6. Other provisions
sections.body: Matters not covered by this agreement are governed by the General Terms of the Extended Warranty. This agreement is a demonstration version; the official terms are the signed electronic PDF agreement, which has full legal effect.
